job.title: Nurse Practitioner
job.description:
Nurse Practitioner | Cairns, Far North Queensland

Applicants from across Australia who are willing to relocate to Cairns are welcome to apply.
Surematch Recruitment is seeking a Nurse Practitioner to join an established integrative medical clinic in Cairns. The clinic brings together GPs and a range of complementary therapies under one roof, giving patients holistic, coordinated care.
This is an exciting opportunity for a compassionate practitioner with strong clinical assessment skills, sound prescribing judgement and a genuine interest in individualised, whole-person care.

About the role

  • Conduct comprehensive consultations, reviewing medical histories, symptoms and previous treatments.
  • Assess patient needs, including contraindications and medication interactions.
  • Develop individualised treatment plans and prescribe where clinically appropriate.
  • Educate patients about their treatment options, benefits, risks and monitoring requirements.
  • Provide follow-up consultations to review progress and adjust care as needed.
  • Maintain accurate clinical records and meet all prescribing and regulatory requirements.
  • Work alongside GPs and allied and complementary therapists to deliver coordinated, multidisciplinary care.

About you

  • Current AHPRA registration with endorsement as a Nurse Practitioner.
  • Strong clinical assessment, reasoning and medication management skills.
  • Ability to practise autonomously within your scope of practice.
  • A compassionate, professional and non-judgemental approach.
  • Excellent communication and patient education skills.
  • Openness to integrative and collaborative models of care.
  • Commitment to safe prescribing and ongoing professional development.
  • Based in Cairns or willing to relocate.

Make the move to Cairns
Looking for a lifestyle change? Continue your clinical career in tropical Far North Queensland, with the reef, rainforest and a relaxed pace of life on your doorstep. Local applicants and those considering relocation from anywhere in Australia are encouraged to apply.

Apply now
Send your CV to admin@surematch.com.au or call 1300 319 100 for a confidential discussion.
